rules.rule: Negative space isolates a subject to make it the focal point; removing it destroys the image's meaning.
rules.evidence: Space around an object is also what makes it read as isolated, and isolation is one of the strongest ways to make something the focal point

rules.rule: If your eye identifies the background as the object, the figure-ground split has gone the wrong way.
rules.evidence: Ask which region your eye calls "the object". If it picks the background, the figure/ground split has gone the wrong way
